description: This file defines a LanceDBManager class responsible for managing LanceDB dependencies, checking binary availability, and installing dependencies within a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: LanceDBManager
classes.description: Manages LanceDB dependencies, including checking binaries, installing dependencies, and cleaning up.

methods.name: getCurrentPlatform
methods.description: Determines current platform info such as OS, architecture, and corresponding package and binary filenames.

methods.name: getDependenciesPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the LanceDB dependencies directory.

methods.name: checkLanceDBBinaries
methods.description: Checks if LanceDB binaries are present and match the expected version.

methods.name: installLanceDBDependencies
methods.description: Installs LanceDB dependencies via npm, creating package.json if necessary.

methods.name: ensureLanceDBAvailable
methods.description: Ensures LanceDB dependencies are installed and available, installing if needed.

methods.name: getNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Returns the node_modules path within dependencies.

methods.name: cleanupDependencies
methods.description: Removes the dependencies directory and its contents.
